strict_rules: Harden levels ONE AT A TIME — only modify the single level file named by the user; never touch other level files.
No level may repeat (unique topology / pattern across the catalog).
Light must touch ALL mirrors before level completes (requiredMirrorBounces == mirror count).
No similar patterns across levels — do not copy used_patterns or used entries in patterns[].
Use walls and pillars smartly (corridor/chamber obstacles + metadata.pillars at hinges).
Room always 1080x1920; mirrors length 145, minAngle 5, maxAngle 175, snapIncrement 0.
intendedSolution must validate via tool/generate_levels_extreme.py simulate/validate (c1 lit, hits == len(mirrors)).
designer canonical_v2_hardened; difficultyBand ch1_extreme or ch1_insane; score roughly 90-97 for hard packs.
WALLS/PILLARS ARE NEVER RANDOM. Every obstacle must have a job: funnel, rail, stopper, shortcut_block, crystal_alcove, or decoy_deadend.
Build walls FROM the solution path (corridor rails + stoppers + skip blockers + crystal alcove). Do not sprinkle islands.
After placing walls, re-simulate. If a wall clips the solution, remove it — do not keep random leftovers.

MIRROR COUNT IS MAP-DRIVEN (not always 14). Use 10-16 corners with hinge gap >= 330. Add mirrors when the layout needs more corners — do not cap at the original file's count. Do NOT default to 10. Prefer 12-16 whenever the lattice has unused corners (use 3x6 at gap 350 if 3x5 cannot host 12+).
NO OVERLAPPING WALLS OR PILLARS. Keep-out 170px from every hinge/crystal/emitter. Deduplicate AABBs.
Do not stack rails+stoppers+pillars at turns. Mid-segment walls only. Game already draws hinge pedestals — never duplicate them.
Do not fill/crowd the map. Every wall/pillar must be useful. Prefer 8-20 walls. Max 2 collision pillars in empty corners.

wall_pillar_rules.summary: Layout first. Space the path. Every wall/pillar has one job. Nothing stacked.
jobs: funnel: trap the light so it can only hit m1 first
rail: corridor walls parallel to each solution segment (gap ~110-120 from beam), inset from hinges so turns stay open
stopper: wall BEHIND each mirror, opposite the solution outgoing, so a wrong angle dies
shortcut_block: wall that crosses a skip line (same x or y as two non-consecutive path points) so the beam cannot jump mirrors
crystal_alcove: lips + far wall so the crystal only opens from the last mirror outgoing
decoy_deadend: at most 1-2 false corridors that LOOK like paths but are closed; they must sit on a tempting wrong turn, not in empty space
pillars: Do NOT put metadata.pillars on hinges (duplicate pedestals).
Collision pillars (shape:pillar) are optional, max 2, in empty corners, 220px from hinges, no overlap with walls.
If a pillar does no blocking job, omit it.
forbidden: Stacked walls on the same turn (rail + stopper + gauntlet + pillar).
Dense 280-grid with 118-offset dual rails (they overlap adjacent corridors).
Filling the map so it looks crowded.
build_order: 1. Place corridor rails on every solution segment (light→m1→…→crystal)
2. Place a stopper behind each hinge (opposite outgoing)
3. Place shortcut blockers on unused collinear skip lines
5. Add at most one false gallery on a real wrong-turn from m1 or m2
6. filter_clear against the solution corridor; drop anything that clips the path
7. Re-simulate: intended solution must still light c1 with hits == mirror count
mirrors: Count is NOT fixed at 14. Use as many corners as the map needs (typically 10-16).
Hinge gap >= 330 (prefer ~400) so mirrors, pedestals, and walls have room.
Longer segments (400-700) instead of packing a dense grid.
walls: Game already draws a pedestal at every mirror hinge — do NOT place a pillar or wall on a hinge.
Keep-out: no obstacle AABB within 170px of hinge, crystal, or emitter.
Mid-segment rails only (inset ~175 from hinges). Never dual-rail + stopper + door stacked at a turn.
No two obstacle AABBs may overlap (pad 10px).
Do not fill empty space. Target ~8-20 walls, not 50+.
Shortcut lids: at most 2, only if they block a real skip to the crystal.
Crystal: one far-wall alcove, not a 3-sided box hugging the last hinge.
At most one decoy pocket, offset from m1, not overlapping rails.
